text:
devon: Starting a new Pulumi module to provision eu-west-3 for GPU capacity. Goal: automated region bring-up (VPC, subnets, node pools with GPU instances), remote state, and CI wiring. Anyone hit quotas or got templates?

paul: +1. For remote state do we want Pulumi Service or s3-based backend? Pulumi Service is easiest but some customers require state in our AWS accounts.

maria: For Dedicated/private deployments we need the state in the customer's account. For our infra stacks we should use S3 + KMS + locking. Use DynamoDB for locks if we ever use Terraform in parallel.

devon: plan: pulp (Pulumi) stacks in S3: redwood-pulumi-state-eu-west-3, encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key. CI will have a role that can assume and push state. PR preview stacks should be ephem (stack name: ci/pr-<num>).

jen: Important: check GPU quotas per AZ before creating node pools. eu-west-3 has limited A100 capacity in some AZs. Open support ticket with cloud provider early.

paul: Agreed. Also add a preflight check in the pipeline that calls AWS DescribeAccountAttributes + EC2 DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings for requested GPU instance types. Fail fast if capacity quotas < required.

devon: Putting the minimal commands here for the CI job:

```bash
# login to s3 backend for pulumi
pulumi login s3://redwood-pulumi-state-eu-west-3
pulumi stack init infra/eu-west-3/prod
pulumi config set aws:region eu-west-3 --stack infra/eu-west-3/prod
pulumi up --stack infra/eu-west-3/prod --yes
```

maria: CI snippet for GitHub Actions:

```yaml
jobs:
  pulumi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: pulumi/actions@v3
        with:
          command: up
          stack: org/infra/eu-west-3/prod
        env:
          AWS_ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.AWS_INFRA_ROLE }}
          PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PULUMI_TOKEN }}
```

devon: We need the pipeline to adopt the following wiring:
- assume-role into infra-account
- use pulumi login s3://redwood-pulumi-state-eu-west-3 (bucket in infra-account)
- use KMS key ARN from secret manager
- PR stacks get auto-destroy after CI succeeds

paul: For state migration (if any): create new stacks and run `pulumi import` for any existing resources that must be preserved. Do not run `pulumi up` to re-create things in prod without a dry-run and approval.

jen: Validation checklist before handoff to platform:
- VPC and subnet cidr allocation validated (no overlap with shared VPCs)
- Route tables and NAT gateways in place
- Security groups locked down to internal control plane IPs
- Node pools provisioned with GPU instance types and taints/labels
- Node autoscaler policies tested
- Metrics/alerting: GPU allocation, node launch failures, and out-of-capacity alerts

maria: Add a small smoke job we can run after provision: schedule a test pod that requests 1 GPU and runs `nvidia-smi` and a short tensor op. Success = GPU nodes correctly attached and mountable.

devon: Example smoke k8s job:

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: gpu-smoke
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: smoke
        image: nvidia/cuda:11.7-base
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
        command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "nvidia-smi && python -c \"import torch;print(torch.cuda.is_available())\""]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

ops-bot: quota-alert: detected low GPU quota in eu-west-3 for account infra-redwood-01. Current available A100: 2. Requested by plan: 8. https://cloud.provider/support/INC-12345 :warning:

paul: ops-bot flagged it — we'll open a capacity request and add a fallback policy to route to eu-west-1 when capacity insufficient. Add routing policy config in the module: `preferred_regions` list and `fallback_regions` map.

maria: CI gating: require manual approval for prod stack apply. Use GitHub environment protection + required reviewers. For stage, allow auto apply on merge.

devon: Handoff notes to platform team (short):
- stacks: infra/eu-west-3/{stage,prod}
- state bucket: redwood-pulumi-state-eu-west-3
- kms: kms://arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:111111111:key/xxxx
- CI role: infra-ci-role@111111111
- smoke job: `k8s/gpu-smoke.yaml` in repo
- validation playbook: run `./scripts/region-validate.sh` (checks VPC, quotas, node counts, smoke job)

jen: small ask: tag all created resources with `team:platform` and `region-provision:eu-west-3` so billing and cleanup easier.

devon: I'll push a draft PR with module + CI changes. Will add a step in pipeline to run `describe-instance-type-offerings` as Paul suggested. Please review the PR and I'll schedule a short handoff sync. :rocket:

ci-bot: Workflow triggered: pulumi/preview for PR #412 by devon on org/infra. Preview stack: ci/pr-412-eu-west-3. Logs: https://ci.redwood/workflows/412

paul: Great — when PR is ready ping me and I'll take care of the infra-account IAM role and S3 bucket policy.

maria: I'll own the smoke test and validation checklist during handoff. Leave a note in the PR describing the manual approval step for prod.

devon: thanks all — aim to have first pass up by EOD tomorrow.
